name: PNG/JPG to AVIF and WebP with Quality Compare

seo.title: PNG/JPG to AVIF and WebP with Quality Compare — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Encode one PNG or JPEG to AVIF and WebP at comparable quality settings and show file-size savings side by side.

assumptions: Native Canvas encoders are preferred; a bundled AVIF codec can be lazy-loaded if native AVIF encoding is unavailable.
limitations: Quality numbers are codec-specific and not visually equivalent; users must judge the preview.
